description_excerpt: Job Description Performs the duties of the Lab supervisor in the absence of the Lab Supervisor, serves as the back-up for this position. Performs the test in compliance with the clients provided manuals and SOP's. Performs a regular checking of the equipments to be used (calibration and verification compliance). Communicates with Customer service staffs for any unclear information that will affect the testing. Communicates with Report team for all information related to test results.
